title: Is Phantom Blade Zero Single-Player? (No Co-op, No MMO)
description: Phantom Blade Zero is a single-player action RPG. There is no co-op, no PvP, and no MMO component. Here is what S-GAME has confirmed, and why the confusion exists.
keyword: is phantom blade zero single player

facts.label: MMO elements
facts.value: None - it is not an MMO

facts.label: Online requirement
facts.value: Not confirmed; no online features announced

sections.title: Short Answer
sections.content:
Yes, Phantom Blade Zero is single-player. There is no co-op, no PvP and no MMO component. S-GAME has not announced any multiplayer or online features of any kind.

The game is a story-driven action RPG built around one character's 66 remaining days. That premise is the reason the design has no multiplayer: the countdown, the branching decisions and the relationship system are all single-player structures.

sections.title: Why People Ask
sections.content:
The confusion is understandable, and it comes from three places.

1. The developer's previous games were mobile online titles

S-GAME built its reputation on Phantom Blade (2014) and Phantom Blade 2 (2017) - mobile action RPGs with online infrastructure. A reader who knows the series but not this entry can reasonably assume Zero continues that model. It does not. S-GAME describes this as an AAA console and PC release, a deliberate move away from the mobile model.

2. "Wuxia" strongly implies MMO to Western players

Chinese martial-arts settings have a long history in the MMO space, so "dark wuxia action RPG" reads to many people as a genre prefix for an online game. Here wuxia is a narrative and aesthetic choice, not a service model.

3. The name gets attached to live-service projects

"Phantom Blade Zero" sounds like a free-to-play reboot naming convention. It is not a reboot, and it is not free-to-play.

sections.title: What Is Actually Confirmed
sections.content:
S-GAME has published a lot of material, but it has never mentioned multiplayer. Concretely:

  • One playable character. The game is catalogued as single-player, and the reference description states plainly that “the player controls the elite assassin Soul”. No second playable character has been announced.
  • Side quests that can branch the story. The official State of Play write-up says interacting with citizens and completing side quests “might even open up new story paths” - single-player depth, not a co-op substitute.
  • Difficulty modes rather than a co-op option. Wayfarer, Hellwalker and Sixty-Six Days are detailed on the difficulty page, each with its source date.
  • A 66-day countdown that the entire structure is built around.

sections.title: Difficulty Modes, Not Co-op
sections.content:
Where a live-service game would offer co-op to widen its audience, Phantom Blade Zero offers difficulty tiers instead. Three modes have been shown, which is unusual for a game with this reputation for challenge:

ModeWho it is for
WayfarerPlayers who mainly want the story
HellwalkerHigher challenge, with adaptive enemy intelligence
Sixty-Six DaysThe hardest option

That is the tell. A game that solves "this might be too hard for some players" with difficulty settings rather than a second player is committed to being single-player.

See the beginner guide for how the combat works in practice.

sections.title: Related Question: Is It a Soulslike?
sections.content:
Also no, though this one is a closer call. The game shares checkpoint-based progression, respawning enemies and boss-centred design with the genre, but its combat feel comes from character-action games and martial arts choreography rather than from stamina management.

The most common comparison from people who have played it is a middle ground between Ninja Gaiden and Sekiro. The full breakdown is on the soulslike page.

sections.title: Caveat
sections.content:
This page describes what S-GAME has announced as of the pre-launch period. Because no multiplayer has ever been mentioned, the honest statement is that there is no co-op or online mode announced rather than a guarantee one will never be added post-launch. If anything changes before or after the October 29, 2026 release, this page is updated.

Check the release date page for the current schedule.
